metadata.title: Local Bazar in Santal Village | संताल गांव की 'हटिया' में क्या क्या बिकता है
metadata.description: Dumka district is part of Santal Pargana in Jharkhand. This city is also known for many tourist places. But if you want to see the real culture and beautiful tribal life, you must visit Santal villages. Our team got a chance to visit some of these villages and met the beautiful people of Santal Adivasi community. The 'HATIYA' (local Bazar) is the most happening place in these areas, where people come to shop and sell their goods.
